elements.name: create

elements.description:
Creates a realtime socket for a client, and binds every other export of this module
onto it. `nakama.create_socket` is the same call reached through the core module.

elements.brief: Opens the socket's websocket connection to the server.
elements.description: Opens the socket's websocket connection to the server.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives whether the connection succeeded, and the error if it did not.

returnvalues.doc: The result, when no callback is given.

elements.description:

message tables and pass them through here.

elements.description:

arguments, and replaces the socket's bound `on_disconnect` method.
